about.description: I have been studying at Universitas Muhammadiyah Semarang since 2023. During that time I built a foundation in Java and expanded into Python, Node.js, React, and full-stack web development through internship projects. Outside of academics, I also create content for TikTok and YouTube, which helps me explain ideas clearly and stay close to how people actually use digital products.
